trigger.description: An explicit include-tombstoned request supplements admitted live index matches with retired source rows scored by in-memory Frankensearch lexical retrieval. The historical archive is read from the pinned source snapshot, including the separately stored user-global lane after its healthy live index has omitted tombstones. Workspace ownership, seals, pending review, revision cutoffs, kind/typed filters and visibility gates still apply. Strict hybrid and semantic-only requests do not acquire lexical supplementation. No source or persisted index is changed.
setup_commands: # In an isolated store, create and tombstone a matching memory, then rebuild its live index so the retired record is no longer indexed.
# Exercise a workspace memory and a user-global memory with global participation enabled; the healthy global generation may be empty or contain unrelated live memories.
